WORK, the most any warm save did, counted by eqc (EQC_TIMINGS), which no machine's load moves: the files it
compiled, the TypeScript modules it wrote, and the files and kilobytes bun wrote. A save of the dashboard's
one screen compiled 1 of 159 files, wrote 1 module and had bun write 2 files, 2.7KB; the cold build did
159, 30 and 285KB. Each number leaves room for one more of the same, and a save that compiles, writes or
bundles the app again fails it whatever the clock says. A warm save that loaded the project cold, instead
of keeping the compilation the save before it loaded, fails too.

saves were 1471 and 1074ms, and dropped pull requests that never touched hot reload from the merge queue. A
loaded runner slows some saves and never makes one faster, so the fastest is what a save costs when nothing
else runs; the medians are still reported beside it. The roadmap's bar is a second. The desktop meets it
